pro_course_detail.description:
This is a classic language learning method. 

Step 1. For homework, I send you one or more of the following: grammar PDF page/s, an article or some vocabulary page/s. You return the file/s to me 24+ hours before the next lesson, and I check it and send it back. 

Step 2. In class, I make you talk using the vocabulary or grammar you have practised, or you explain the article to me and I then ask you questions about the theme. 

Vocabulary and articles can be general English, business English, academic English, or anything you please.

teacher_info.introduction:
Hello and welcome to italki. 


Perhaps this is your first time and the thought of talking with an online teacher is a little strange. If so, don’t worry, it’s a wonderful way to communicate. 


Or perhaps you are familiar with Skype lessons and are looking for a new teacher. I hope my engaging and innovative classes will help you achieve your goals.


I offer 4 kinds of lesson:


       1.  Unique, structured English lessons


These classes are based on an unusual or thought provoking story. During these classes we will practice the whole range of English skills. Before the class I will send an email with materials for the class and a video to watch before we start. You will learn new vocabulary, read for gist (general meaning) and specific information then move towards a discussion, debate or role play and use the new vocabulary to discuss the topic confidently and naturally. I will always encourage you to express yourself while at the same time occasionally pointing out any common mistakes or important grammar points. 


     2.  CAE, CPE and IELTS speaking practice


During these 1-hour classes we will do 2 mock (or practice) exams. I will also give feedback about where you could improve, give you tips about keeping within time limits and things the examiner will be looking for.


    3.  Current affairs discussion classes


During these 1-hour long classes we will discuss several current affairs topics from around the world.


   4.  Proof-reading / writing classes


These classes will help you to write more concisely, fluidly and accurately. Students normally send me writing before the class then, during the class, using GoogleDocs, we look at the suggestions I have made and make any other appropriate changes. All of the writing is stored on GoogleDocs to keep a record of all the writing you do.


If you have any other needs please send me a message and let me know. I look forward to meeting you soon.


Kindest wishes


Daniel
